verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਸਿਝੈ ਚੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: jo gur gopai aapanaa kiau sijhai chelaa|

en.bdb: If the disciple does not know (tell) about his guru, how could he get liberated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਲੁ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਜਮ ਪੰਥਿ ਇਕੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)gal ghat chalaieeaai jam pa(n)th ikelaa|

en.bdb: Bound in chains, he is forced to walk alone on the way of the Yama, death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਈ ਨਰਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਹੁ ਖਰਾ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: lahai sajaiee narak vich uh kharaa dhuhelaa|

en.bdb: In dilemma he stands and suffers hell.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਉਦਿਆਂ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh chauraaseeh bhaudhiaa(n) fir hoi na melaa|

en.bdb: Though he transmigrates in the eighty four lac species of life yet he does not meet the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਜੂਏ ਖੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: janam padhaarath haariaa jiau jooe khelaa|

en.bdb: Like the playing of gamble, he loses the invaluable stake of life in this game.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਧੁਨੈ ਉਹੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਵੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: hath maroRai sir dhunai uh lahai na velaa ||2||

en.bdb: At the end (of life) he has jitters and lamentations but the time gone never returns.
